weekend_note: Sunny and dry all week: highs in the upper 70s, lows in the mid to upper 50s, and no rain in the forecast through Sunday. Picks: Blue Angels practice today, free Opera After Dark Friday and SevilleStock Saturday downtown, the Interstate Fair opening Thursday, Boo at the Zoo's remaining weekends and Ice Flyers on Saturday (indoors at the Bay Center). Storm cancellations: Taste of Gulf Breeze is canceled with refunds, and this week's Bands on the Beach and Cinemas in the Sand were reported canceled.

news.title: City of Pensacola: debris estimate $16 million, recycling returns Oct 26, 14 parks reopen
news.summary: The Oct 19 update says about 1.07 million cubic yards of debris have been collected, curbside recycling resumes Oct 26 and 14 parks have reopened.

news.title: Governor asks FEMA for disaster declaration; state brings travel trailers
news.summary: DeSantis said the state requested a federal declaration for eight counties. Nearly 300 trailer applications came in across four counties, and $5,000 grants began going to affected first responders.

news.title: Escambia, Pensacola reach threshold to seek federal disaster declaration
news.summary: The Oct 16 update says the damage totals meet the state threshold, which would open FEMA public and individual aid. Residents are asked to log damage on the county report site even if they do not plan to claim aid.

news.title: Bayview Senior Center serves as storm recovery resource center
news.summary: Open 7 AM to 7 PM daily as a one-stop spot for recovery help, with free county transit rides offered.

news.title: Taste of Gulf Breeze canceled; tickets refunded
news.summary: The Gulf Breeze Chamber canceled the Oct 23 event as recovery continues. No new date is set, and all ticket purchases are being refunded.

news.title: Escambia schools, UWF and Pensacola State scheduled to resume Oct 19
news.summary: Classes were set to restart Monday after the storm closures. UWF nature trails stay closed until further notice.

news.title: Dry, sunny stretch ahead, with drought and fire-weather worries
news.summary: Forecasters see little to no rain through the weekend and into late October, which could worsen drought, and no tropical threat for 7 to 10 days.

coverage_note: Written overnight Tuesday Oct 20. Temperatures come from the National Weather Service forecast issued Oct 18 (the latest I could open), with rain set to 0% because it shows no precipitation and FOX10's Oct 19 outlook calls for essentially none; the forecast stops at Oct 25 because no source gave later days. Weather.com's page was stale and not used. NorthEscambia.com could not be opened (blocked), so Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah and Cantonment items are carried over from the Allevents listing and were not rechecked. Visit Pensacola's calendar, Saenger, Ice Flyers, WEAR and PNJ were mostly unreachable; Ice Flyers dates after Oct 24, Game Days, Palafox Market and the later events were carried over. Cancellations come from Must Do Pensacola and Local Pulse and may change. No restaurant openings were confirmed.
